welcomeTagline: Verbal autopsy interviews and cause-of-death coding, on or off the network.
welcomeScanHint: From your supervisor or the welcome email
welcomeManualTitle: Sign in with email or mobile
welcomeManualHint: If your organisation gave you a password
welcomeStandaloneHint: No server. Interviews stay on this phone
enrolCheckServer: Check the server before you enrol.
textSizeNote: Text size also follows the phone's font size setting.
highContrastNote: Darker text and stronger edges, in light and dark mode.
unlockSubtitle: Enter your PIN to unlock this phone.
refusalPanelLead: The interview will not continue. These details are optional.
settingsPhoneNote: The phone uses one mode at a time; switching saves and locks open work, nothing is deleted. Questionnaire language is chosen inside each form.
stateEmptyHintNoRegister: No cases on this phone yet. Pull down to refresh.
localCasesEmptyTitle: Nothing to code on this phone
localCasesEmptyHint: Completed interviews that have not been sent appear here.
help_coding_what: Your coding queue: pick or receive a case, and look back at the cases you have coded.
help_coding_do1: Choose a project, then open Available to pick a case or start a random one.
help_coding_do2: Open My coded cases to view a finished case or recode it while the recode window is open.
help_coding_do3: Finish or release the case you hold before starting another.
help_case_what: One case: read the interview in its sections, then record the cause of death.
help_case_do1: Move between sections with the tabs under the title.
help_case_do2: Open the Cause of death section to assess the case and save.
help_case_do3: Save your notes before you leave; release the case if you cannot finish it.
